hints.title: Two Maps
hints.text: Track the current color of each ball and the frequency of each assigned color.

hints.title: Color Update
hints.text: When recoloring ball x, decrement the count of its previous color and remove it from the map if count becomes 0.

hints.title: Distinct Colors Count
hints.text: Increment the count of the new color in the frequency map. The number of active distinct colors is the size of the frequency map.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Each query performs O(1) hash map operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating over limit + 1 balls takes up to 10^9 operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(q) space storing only updated balls.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use dual hash tables to maintain dynamic distinct color counts in O(1) per query.
